global.description: Values shared with parent/sibling charts when this chart is used as a dependency. Not used by this chart.

pnID.description: Scaleway private network ID the VIPs are booked from. Required.

resyncPeriod.description: Full drift-resync interval as a Go duration (e.g. "10m"). Empty uses the controller default.

extraArgs.description: Extra arguments appended to the controller command line.

replicaCount.description: Number of controller replicas. Run at least 2 (spread across nodes) in production; leader election is enabled automatically whenever this is > 1.

tolerations.description: Pod tolerations (Kubernetes Toleration objects, passed through).

affinity.description: Pod affinity (Kubernetes Affinity object, passed through).

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Pod topologySpreadConstraints (passed through). Empty renders a default constraint spreading replicas across kubernetes.io/hostname.

podAnnotations.description: Extra annotations for the controller pods.

podLabels.description: Extra labels for the controller pods.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names and labels.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the fully qualified resource name prefix.

Scaleway.description: Scaleway API credentials, exposed to the controller as SCW_* environment variables. Set existingSecret, or all four inline values to have the chart render the Secret.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret carrying SCW_ACCESS_KEY, SCW_SECRET_KEY, SCW_DEFAULT_PROJECT_ID and SCW_DEFAULT_REGION. Takes precedence over the inline values.

accessKey.description: Scaleway access key (IPAM read/write + Instance read). Ignored when existingSecret is set.

secretKey.description: Scaleway secret key. Ignored when existingSecret is set.

projectID.description: Scaleway project the IPAM IPs are booked in. Ignored when existingSecret is set.

region.description: Region of the IPAM IPs, e.g. fr-par. Ignored when existingSecret is set.

tag.description: Image tag. Images are tagged with the git commit SHA; there is no moving tag.

PodDisruptionBudget.description: PodDisruptionBudget for the controller. Only rendered when replicaCount > 1.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum unavailable replicas (integer or percentage string).

MetricsService.description: ClusterIP Service in front of the /metrics endpoints.

annotations.description: Extra annotations for the metrics Service.

ServiceMonitor.description: Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor scraping all replicas.

enabled.description: Create the ServiceMonitor (requires the Prometheus Operator CRDs).

labels.description: Extra labels for the ServiceMonitor (e.g. to match a Prometheus serviceMonitorSelector).

name.description: ServiceAccount name. Empty derives it from the chart fullname (or uses "default" when create is false).

Cilium.description: Cilium L2-announcement enablement for clusters (like stock Scaleway Kapsule) where it is not configured.

CiliumL2AnnouncementPolicy.description: CiliumL2AnnouncementPolicy making Cilium answer ARP for the VIPs.

interfaces.description: Regexes of the interfaces the VIPs are announced on (Kapsule private-network NICs are ensX).

nodeSelector.description: Nodes announcing the VIPs (Kubernetes LabelSelector, passed through).

serviceSelector.description: Services the policy announces (Kubernetes LabelSelector, passed through). Empty selects all.

KapsuleBootstrap.description: Kapsule-specific enablement: CiliumNodeConfig turning enable-l2-announcements on for all nodes, plus the lease RBAC for the cilium ServiceAccount that the upstream Cilium chart would create with l2announcements.enabled=true.

enabled.description: Create the CiliumNodeConfig and the cilium lease Role/RoleBinding. Disable if your Cilium already has L2 announcements properly enabled.
